title: Unable to access app for months and essential banking functions are affected
text:
For at least the past 3 to 5 months, every time I try to open the HSBC app, it gets stuck on the logo screen for around 10 to 20 seconds and then crashes and closes by itself. This has been happening repeatedly and has never been properly resolved. My open is an iPhone 13 and on iOS 18, guess this app is not compatible to the latest iPhone??? lol? I need to get a new iPhone just so to use this app??

This is no longer a minor app issue. I cannot use the app for authentication when making online credit card transactions, which means some payments may not go through at all. I am also unable to use FPS properly, check my account balance, confirm whether my salary has been credited, or review how much I owe on my credit card and when the payment due date is.

These are all basic banking functions that customers rely on regularly. When the app cannot be accessed, it affects not only convenience but also payment planning, cash flow visibility, and the ability to avoid overdue charges or missed deadlines. Seriously I can’t even purchase things online, get a show tickets, book a restaurants or just simply get grocery online  

What makes this more frustrating is that the problem has already continued for months without being properly resolved.

I’m honestly just so glad I didn’t put all my egg into this basket and haven’t made my mortgage or adopted any investments instruments on this platform. Otherwise my finance is as good as doomed

I hope HSBC will treat this as a serious service issue. So frustrated that I write my first app review in my life because of this. Do better.
